no_outcome_promised.note: The draft acknowledges the requests to stop calls and to receive written confirmation ('We have noted both requests') without promising that either will happen.

no_liability_admitted.note: The apology is for the stress the customer described, which is sympathetic. It does not concede that the bank or its collectors did anything wrong.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned, and there is no judgment on whether the call practices were permissible.

no_invented_specifics.note: All details (call counts, after 9pm, Sunday 7am, the 9/14 promise to pay on the 15th, newborn, credit card) come from the note. Apart from the standard 10-business-day timeframe, no procedures or policies are added, and the rep's internal contact-limit notation is not stated as fact.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of account notations, flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: The draft covers call frequency, late-night and early-Sunday timing, the prior payment commitment, the impact on the newborn, the request to stop calls, and the request for written confirmation.

tone.note: Warm and plain, with genuine empathy about the newborn. It is not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: Events are framed as the customer's account ('As you told us', 'You mentioned', 'You said'). The draft says only 'a specialist team' without naming Collections & Recoveries, and takes no position on the substance.
